name: Greater Holy Light
description: (Tag:light)Conjure and shape searing Holy Light used by high-ranking Angels, or call it down from the sky. It sets Infernal, Unholy, or Necrotic opponents alight on contact, burns away same-attribute attacks and curses, and spares anything you do not wish to hurt. Significantly reduced potency otherwise. (A/N: Holy Light is NOT light speed despite the name).
